statement: External MotionPlus mode 04 is standalone, 05 Nunchuk passthrough and 07 Classic passthrough; kernel/wiiuse consumers reuse these control modes across their recognized remotes. The six-byte MP gyro frame extension_connected flag denotes the downstream accessory, not whether the built-in gyro physically exists. Therefore integrated Plus with no Nunchuk can have MP present and connected flag false. This last integrated interpretation is source-derived and unmeasured; integrated Nunchuk/Classic bit mapping and active status transition timing remain unknown.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux v6.12 core.c 470-565; wiiuse motion_plus.c 175-205,238-316; Dolphin MotionPlus.h 77-115; WiiBrew oldid120079 mode and gyro-bit descriptions. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
